name.value: Chaiiwala of London - King George Hub

description.value: Chaiiwala of London is a South Asian-inspired chai cafe serving globally popular drinks like Karak Chaii and Pink Chaii alongside street food such as samosas, Aloo Paratha, and Butter Chicken Poutine. Located at King George Hub just one to two minutes' walk from the King George SkyTrain station, it's a convenient urban rest stop for cyclists connecting to the transit network. The cafe has outdoor seating, accepts cash and cards, and is wheelchair accessible.
